starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Is there any chance you could help me?

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.

starting-off.speaker: Caroline
starting-off.text: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
If the player's Firemaking level is less than 30:

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

starting-off.text: If the player's Firemaking level is 30 or above:

steps.player: I suppose so, how do I get there?

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: That's very good of you [player name]. My friend Holgart will take you there.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.

steps.player: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: That's a shame.

steps.player: Bye.

steps.speaker: Caroline
steps.text: Bye.

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.speaker: Caroline
starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.text: Brave [player name], have you any news about my son and his father?

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.player: I'm working on it now Caroline.

starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.speaker: Caroline
starting-off-talking-to-caroline-again.text: Please bring them back safe and sound.

talking-to-holgart.player: I would like a ride on your boat to the fishing platform.

talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart.text: I'm afraid it isn't sea worthy, it's full of holes. To fill the holes I'll need some swamp paste.

talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart.text: Yes, swamp tar mixed with flour and heated over a fire.
If the player already has one swamp paste in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: In fact, unless me nose be mistaken, you've got some in yer pack.

steps.player: Oh yes, I forgot about that stuff. Can you use it?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Aye, that be perfect.
You give Holgart the swamp paste.
Cutscene starts, focusing on Holgart fixing the boat.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Right me hearty. Let's get this boat fixed.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Huzzah! We've fixed the leaky old tub.

talking-to-holgart.text: If the player does not have swamp tar:

steps.player: Where can I find swamp tar?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge. It's too far for an old man like me to travel.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: If you make me some swamp paste I'll give you a ride in my boat.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.text: Hello m'hearty. Did you manage to make some swamp paste?
If the player does not have swamp tar:

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: It's simply swamp tar mixed with flour heated over a fire. Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: I can't fix my row boat without it.

steps.player: Ok, I'll try to find some.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-ag.text: If the player has swamp tar:

steps.player: Yes, I have some here.

steps.text: Cutscene starts, focusing on Holgart fixing the boat.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Right me hearty. Let's get this boat fixed.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Huzzah! We've fixed the leaky old tub.

talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-af.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-talking-to-holgart-af.text: Hello again land lover. There's some strange goings on, on that platform, I tell you.

steps.player: Will you take me there?

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Of course m'hearty. If that's what you want.
You arrive at the fishing platform.

steps.player: I'm keeping away from there.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Fair enough m'hearty.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-holga.text: Have you had enough of this place yet? It's really starting to scare me.

options.text: No, I'm going to stay a while.

steps.player: No, I'm going to stay a while.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Okay... you're the boss.

steps.player: Okay, let's go back.

steps.speaker: Holgart
steps.text: Okay m'hearty, jump on.
Holgart takes the player back to Witchaven.

at-the-fishing-platform-taking-a-sea-slu.text: You pick up the sea slug.
It sinks its teeth deep into your hand.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: What? Who are you? Come inside quickly!

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I'm trying to find out what happened to a boy named Kennith.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Oh you mean Kent's son. He's around somewhere, probably hiding if he knows what's good for him.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: Hiding from what? What's got you so frightened?

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Haven't you seen all those things out there?

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: It all began about a week ago. We pulled up a haul of deep sea flatfish. Mixed in with them we found those slug things, but thought nothing of it.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: Not long after that my friends began to change, now they spend all day pulling in hauls of fish, only to throw back the fish and keep those nasty sea slugs.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: What am I supposed to do with those? I haven't figured out how to kill one yet, if I put them near the stove they squirm and jump away.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I doubt they would taste too good.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: This is no time for humour.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.player: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.speaker: Bailey
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-baile.text: That's okay. I just can't shake the feeling that this is the start of something... Terrible.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.speaker: Kennith
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.text: He went to get help days ago.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.speaker: Kennith
at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.text: The nasty fishermen tried to throw me and daddy into the sea. So he told me to hide here.

at-the-fishing-platform-talking-to-kenni.player: That's good advice, you stay here and I'll go try and find your father.

at-the-fishing-platform-subsequent-dialo.text: If the player kicks the loose panel near Kennith:

steps.text: You kick the loose panel.
But nothing interesting happens.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.player: Holgart, something strange is going on here.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.text: You're telling me, none of the sailors seem to remember who I am.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.player: Apparently Kennith's father left for help a couple of days ago.

talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.speaker: Holgart
talking-to-holgart-after-talking-to-kenn.text: That's a worry, no-one's heard from him on shore. Come on, we'd better go look for him.
You arrive on a small island.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.text: Someway off mainland still. You'd better see if me old matey's okay.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Oh thank Saradomin! I thought I'd be left out here forever.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.player: Your wife sent me out to find you and your boy. Kennith's fine by the way, he's on the platform.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: I knew the row boat wasn't sea worthy. I couldn't risk bringing him along but you must get him off that platform.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Five days ago we pulled in a huge catch. As well as fish we caught small slug like creatures, hundreds of them.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: That's when the fishermen began to act strange.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: It was the sea slugs, they attach themselves to your body and somehow take over the mind of the carrier.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: I told Kennith to hide until I returned but I was washed up here.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: Please go back and get my boy, you can send help for me later.
Kent notices a sea slug in your torso.
He pulls a sea slug from under your top.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-kent.text: A few more minutes and that thing would have full control of your body.

at-the-shipwreck-island-subsequent-dialo.speaker: Kent
at-the-shipwreck-island-subsequent-dialo.text: Oh my, I must get back to shore.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.player: We'd better get back to the platform so we can see what's going on.

at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.speaker: Holgart
at-the-shipwreck-island-talking-to-holga.text: You're right. It all sounds pretty creepy.
You arrive at the fishing platform.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: Oh, thank the gods it's you. They've all gone mad I tell you, one of the fishermen tried to throw me into the sea!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.player: They're all being controlled by the sea slugs.
I need to get Kennith off this platform, but I can't get past the fishermen.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: The sea slugs are scared of heat, I figured that out when I tried to cook them.
If the player has no space in their inventory:

steps.text: Bailey gives you a torch.
The unlit torch is dropped to the ground.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: If the player has one free space in their in their inventory:

steps.text: an unlit torch

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: I doubt the fishermen will come near you if you can get this torch lit.

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: The only problem is all the wood and flint are damp... I can't light a thing!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey.text: If the player loses their unlit torch:

steps.player: I've managed to lose my torch.

steps.speaker: Bailey
steps.text: That was silly, fortunately I have another. Here, take it.
an unlit torch

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-again.player: I'd better find a way to light this torch, and soon.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player attempts to use the tinderbox on damp sticks:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player attempts to use the tinderbox on an unlit torch:

steps.text: Your tinderbox is damp from the sea crossing. It won't light here.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player lights a fire upstairs and uses damp sticks on the fire:

steps.text: You can't cook that.

rescuing-kennith-interacting-with-the-it.text: If the player rotates the crane upstairs:

steps.text: You rotate the crane around.

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player uses the broken glass on the damp sticks:

steps.text: The player uses the broken glass to heat up the damp sticks.
a pair of dry sticks

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player attempts to rub the dry sticks without level 30 Firemaking:

steps.text: You rub together the dry sticks but nothing happens.
You need a Firemaking level of 30 or above.

rescuing-kennith-making-a-fire.text: If the player attempts to rub the dry sticks with at least level 30 Firemaking:

steps.text: If the player gets the sticks but does not get a fire:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks smoke momentarily then die out.
If the player gets the sticks to start a fire:
If the player does not have an unlit torch (or has an unlit candle or lantern instead) in their inventory:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks catch alight.
The sticks smoke momentarily then die out.
If the player has an unlit torch in their inventory:
You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks catch alight.
You place the smoulding twigs to your torch.
Your torch lights.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.player: I've managed to light the torch.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: Well done traveller, you'd better get Kennith out of here soon.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: The fishermen are becoming stranger by the minute, and they keep pulling up those blasted sea slugs.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.player: Don't worry I'm working on it.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.speaker: Bailey
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-with-.text: Just be sure to watch your back. The fishermen seem to have taken notice of you.

rescuing-kennith-attempting-to-go-upstai.text: You attempt to climb up the ladder.
and smack you on the head with a fishing rod!

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.player: You'll be able to see him soon. First we need to get you back to land, come with me to the boat.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.speaker: Kennith
rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.text: I'm scared of those nasty sea slugs. I won't go near them.

rescuing-kennith-talking-to-kennith.player: Okay, you wait here and I'll go figure another way to get you out.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on any sea slug:

steps.text: The sea slug curls up into its shell.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on a possessed fisherman:

steps.text: The fisherman covers his face.
He seems afraid of your torch.

rescuing-kennith-using-the-lit-torch.text: If the player uses the lit torch on the ice cube:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

freeing-kennith.text: If the player kicks the loose panel near Kennith after talking to Bailey:

steps.text: You kick the loose panel.
The wood is rotten and crumbles away...
leaving an opening big enough for Kennith to climb through.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-kennith-after.text: If there are sea slugs or fishermen nearby:

steps.text: He doesn't seem interested in talking.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-kennith-after.text: If there are no sea slugs or fishermen nearby:

steps.player: Kennith, I've made an opening in the wall. You can come out through there.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Are there any sea slugs on the other side?

steps.player: Not one.
Kennith, I've made an opening in the wall. You can come out through there.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Are there any sea slugs on the other side?

steps.player: Not one.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: How will I get downstairs?

steps.player: I'll figure that out in a moment.

steps.speaker: Kennith
steps.text: Ok, when you have I'll come out.

freeing-kennith-subsequent-dialogue-with.text: He doesn't seem interested in talking.

freeing-kennith-using-the-crane.text: If the player is too far away from the crane:

steps.text: I need to get closer to that.

freeing-kennith-using-the-crane.text: If the player is one tile from the crane:

steps.text: Kennith scrambles through the broken wall...
Down below, you see Holgart collect the boy from the crane and lead him away to safety.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Hello again. I saw you managed to get Kennith off the platform. Well done. He wasn't safe around those slugs.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: Are you going to come back with us?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: No, these fishermen are my friends, I'm sure they can be saved. I'm going to stay and try to get rid of all these slugs.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: Do you have a way of removing the slugs once they've attached themselves to someone?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Not yet but I'll keep working on it.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: I only hope they stay confined to the fishing platform.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: Yes, I dread to think what would happen if they got to Witchaven nearby.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.speaker: Bailey
freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.text: I guess I'll just have to keep an eye on things here until a way of removing the slugs can be found.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-bailey-after-.player: You're braver than most. Take care of yourself Bailey.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.player: Did you get the kid back to shore?

freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.speaker: Holgart
freeing-kennith-talking-to-holgart.text: Yes, he's safe and sound with his parents. Your turn to return to land now adventurer.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Kennith told me about the strange goings-on at the platform. I had no idea it was so serious.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: I could have lost my son and my husband if it wasn't for you.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.player: We found Kent stranded on an island.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Yes, Holgart told me and sent a rescue party out. Kent's back home now, resting with Kennith. I don't think he'll be doing any fishing for a while.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Here, take these Oyster pearls as a reward. They're worth quite a bit and can be used to make lethal crossbow bolts.

freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.speaker: Caroline
freeing-kennith-talking-to-caroline.text: Thank you. Take care of yourself [player name].
